$comment: README auto-update workflow SSOT (Issue #180). Consumed by .github/workflows/readme-autoupdate.yml and scripts/ci/readme-sync.sh. This file is always loaded from the origin/main ref (trusted) by the workflow - never from the PR head - because it defines the security enforcement boundary (managedFiles, comment identity) and the pinned model/version. The model is intentionally fixed to opencode/big-pickle and cannot be overridden by repository variables or PR-controlled configuration; verify-config fails closed on any other value. Per Issue #244 the bot no longer pushes commits to a PR head branch (a bot-authored HEAD leaves required CI in action_required with 0 jobs); it only posts an advisory PR comment referencing the candidate README artifact.

notify.title: README update candidate available
notify.instructions: A validated README update candidate was generated for this PR but was NOT applied. The bot never pushes commits to the PR head branch (Issue #244): a github-actions[bot]-authored HEAD leaves required CI in action_required with 0 jobs. To apply, fold the candidate README content into a normal commit; doing so changes the head SHA, so required CI and review re-run on the new head. To decline, reply "decline" or take no action. This notification is advisory, not a merge gate: when you approve this PR you are also deciding whether to carry the candidate.
